skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals a 2-hit combo of 65% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 5-hit combo of 28% ATK DMG to each enemy in the entire row, with a 100% chance to inflict [Burn] on the main target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 80% ATK), and a 50% chance to inflict [Burn] on other targets in the same row for 2 turns (DoT equal to 80% ATK).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 5-hit combo of 35% ATK DMG to each enemy in the entire row, with a 100% chance to inflict [Burn] on the main target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 90% ATK), and a 50% chance to inflict [Burn] on other targets in the same row for 2 turns (DoT equal to 90% ATK).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by 20%. After an enemy in the [Burn] state acts, Subterranean King immediately performs a [Follow-up] (attacking with 80% of the Basic Attack's DMG and effects, up to 3 times per turn).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by 20%. After an enemy in the [Burn] state acts, Subterranean King immediately performs a [Follow-up] (attacking with 120% of the Basic Attack's DMG and effects, up to 3 times per turn).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by 20%. After an enemy in the [Burn] state acts, Subterranean King immediately performs a [Follow-up] (attacking with 130% of the Basic Attack's DMG and effects, up to 3 times per turn).

effects.desc: Continuous fire damage over time to the target.
Extra attack outside of turn. Disabled by [Lock] and [Blind].
